course_summary:
ISEN 691 | Research | Fall 2026
Instructor: Thomas Ferris | tferris@tamu.edu
Meets: coordinated meetings each week | HF&CS lab
Grading: Midterm deliverable [30%], Final deliverable [50%], Weekly meeting attendance and updates [20%] A: 90-100%, B: 80-89%, C: 70-79%, D: 60-69%, F: <60%
Topics: IRB approval, human-subjects study, experimental protocol design, human perception mechanisms, human performance effects, statistical testing, statistical analyses, literature review, results compilation, results analysis, data collection, recruitment planning, testing, analysis finalization, Midterm results presentation, journal article drafting, Introduction (of journal article), Methods (of journal article), Results (of journal article), Discussion (of journal article), final report refinement, final report revision, technical report writing, final research report, peer-reviewed journal outlets, peer-reviewed publication, lab presentations, research project, industrial engineering field
